findings.title: F-007 correction record contains unmarked stale group-count assertions
evidence: AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md:98 declares that scripts/20_test_checks.py emits 40 groups, while :99 says stale declarations were corrected to 36 and :101 says the same command yields 36.
The current executable has 40 numbered groups; README.md:16, results/objective2/CURRENT_STATUS.md:42, and EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md:805 consistently declare 40.

reproduce: python3 -c 'import re, pathlib; t=pathlib.Path("scripts/20_test_checks.py").read_text(); print("emitted=", len(re.findall(r"print\(\"\\n\[(\d+)\]", t)))'; sed -n '96,102p' AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md

proposed_check: C-NAV-004 — enumerate every regression-suite count assertion in tracked current and correction records, require it either to equal the source-derived numbered-group count or to carry an explicit historical/superseded marker; a fixture retaining the present unmarked 'corrected to 36' or '→ 36' lines when the suite emits 40 must fail.

verified_closed_findings.verification_summary: In an isolated copy of the fixed commit, xrd_protocol_kernel.analyse_single recomputed DOC as 49.030543–65.218597% from the committed raw .txt/.mdi, agreeing with xrd/results/summary_metrics.csv and the current 49–65% README statement. The prior 46–60% value is explicitly superseded, and restoring it unmarked caused regression group [40] to fail with exit 1.

summary: F-014 is independently verified closed. No blocking finding was observed at the fixed commit; F-015 is a non-blocking but actionable count-record inconsistency.

coverage.method: Enumerated the fixed tree, read all six paths changed by the audited commit and targeted authority/raw XRD paths, ran the clean-copy regression suite, independently recomputed the high-impact DOC claim, and performed repository-wide text sweeps for DOC and regression-count assertions.
not_examined: No independent re-execution or numerical recomputation of the full Objective 1/2 DFT and MLIP raw corpus beyond the clean-copy regression suite.
No remote-HPC, instrument, or uncommitted external evidence was accessed.
